label: context.reference
text:
Use Cloud Work through world_cloud_work. Project EE policy must admit it; the task needs the exact interface binding and this artifact binding. Current cloud_work.status from the interface life establishes liveness; installation or connection alone does not.

Send cloud_work.request with an exact catalog operation id and valid arguments. Creation explicitly supplies environment, branch, prompt, attempt count and optional starting-diff artifact ref; the interface reads no ambient workspace state. It emits cloud_work.progress, cloud_work.status, cloud_work.attempt, cloud_work.result, cloud_work.diff, cloud_work.apply_candidate or cloud_work.failure.

cloud_work.apply_candidate reports applied=false and effect_status=not_applied. Preserve its immutable diff/ref and digest, source task/attempt evidence, target root-slot/branch/base evidence and review handoff. To apply, use a separately bound run in git_worktree with an authored required_verified_artifacts review requirement: operator.approval through operator_approval. Only after that mark is admitted may the receiving run's granted tool materialize and apply the reviewed diff against the target evidence. Cloud Work has no filesystem/git authority and cannot report apply success.
